title: Sweetness
description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him.

title: Universal Soldier
description: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

title: Queen of the Damned
description: The vampire Lestat awakens after 100 years, becomes a rock star and unites with a female counterpart.

title: Ghost in the Shell
description: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: Homestead
description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

title: Just Go With It
description: A plastic surgeon (Adam Sandler) enlists the aid of his assistant (Jennifer Aniston) and her children to help him win the heart of a beautiful woman.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

title: Dexter: Resurrection
description:
S02 E03 — Live Free and Die
Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on; as Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD Homicide, mounting pressure, old rivals and dangerous suspects threaten to derail the hunt.

title: The Godfather
description: Crime boss Vito Corleone and his sons, the ruthless yet loyal members of the Corleone family, rule their secretive New York empire with an iron fist.

title: The Godfather Part II
description: Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) rules his father's criminal empire, while flashbacks recall young Vito's (Robert De Niro) climb to power.

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: Baby Driver
description: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: The Back-up Plan
description: A single woman (Jennifer Lopez) meets the man (Alex O'Loughlin) of her dreams on the same day she becomes pregnant through artificial insemination.

title: We're the Millers
description: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

title: Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman.

title: Twister
description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

title: First Blood
description: Green Beret veteran Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff (Brian Dennehy) and the National Guard.

title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
description: A former Green Beret goes on a reconnaissance mission to spring MIAs from a Viet Cong prison.

title: Rambo III
description: Former Special Forces agent John Rambo blasts through Soviet-occupied Afghanistan in search of his captive mentor.

title: The Equalizer 2
description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

title: V for Vendetta
description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

title: Pike River
description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

title: Happy Christmas
description: An immature party girl (Anna Kendrick) moves in with her brother's family to get over a breakup and throws their lives out of whack.

title: A.C.O.D.
description: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book.

title: Horrible Bosses
description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

title: Grizzly Night
description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

title: Pike River
description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

title: Ballistic
description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

title: Dexter: Resurrection
description:
S02 E03 — Live Free and Die
Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on; as Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD Homicide, mounting pressure, old rivals and dangerous suspects threaten to derail the hunt.

title: It Gets Worse
description:
S01 E03 — Sam
Sam's moral high ground is tested at a warehouse sex party, where she invites her new hook-up Tess; the trio tries to maintain control over their love lives, leading to impulsive decisions that could ruin everything.

title: It Gets Worse
description:
S01 E04 — Abi / Ethan / Sam
Ethan and Abi show up to support Sam's reading of new work; but when a short film from the warehouse sex party plays, they are forced to confront how much they've changed since meeting.

title: Killer Joe
description: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
description: Dignified Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) joins his wild nephew in a Sicilian vendetta involving the Vatican.

title: Ballistic
description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

title: Seabiscuit
description: A jockey (Tobey Maguire), an automobile magnate (Jeff Bridges) and a trainer (Chris Cooper) lead a racehorse to glory during the Great Depression.

title: The Death of Stalin
description: When dictator Joseph Stalin dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

title: Up in the Air
description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

title: Quantum of Solace
description: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.
